description: This file defines the IReminderRegistry interface, which manages reminders within the Orleans framework. It includes methods for registering, unregistering, and retrieving reminders associated with grains.

classes.name: IReminderRegistry
classes.description: An interface for managing reminders in Orleans, allowing grains to register, unregister, and query reminders.

methods.name: RegisterOrUpdateReminder
methods.description: Registers or updates a reminder for the current grain with specified timing.

methods.name: UnregisterReminder
methods.description: Unregisters a specified reminder from the current grain.

methods.name: GetReminder
methods.description: Retrieves a specific reminder by name for the current grain.

methods.name: GetReminders
methods.description: Retrieves all reminders registered to the current grain.
